description:
No Stream. Enumerable.reduce already carries :cont/:halt/:suspend (lib/enumerable.fz). Distill line 16: path |> File.stream!() |> Stream.map(&JSON.decode!/1) |> Enum.to_list().

Approved page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.18.html (2026-11-08). Two library structs with defimpl Enumerable: Stream (lib/stream.fz; map/2 prepends to funs; reduce composes funs onto the reducer and hands it to the source's reduce) and File.Stream (lib/file_stream.fz; File.stream!/1 in lib/file.fz fills every field explicitly). The handle held across reducer calls is the resource File.open returns; the impl reads its payload with .value and closes with File.close (a claim), so close is exactly once on :done, :halt, or by the destructor if a suspended continuation is dropped. Decided: lines are read by one runtime helper fz_file_read_line(c_pointer) :: any answering [] or [line] (fz_float_parse's shape); the missing-file fixture is an abort with fz's 'I/O error' text until the errno ticket binds it to the oracle; the rest of Stream and File.stream!/2,3 is its own ticket.
title: Stream.map and File.stream!/1 read lines lazily
